project.description: Runs the tests, builds ghcr.io/harkenn-project/server-docker and pushes :latest and :<sha>. Definition lives in server-docker at jenkins/build-image.xml.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
set -eu IMAGE=ghcr.io/harkenn-project/server-docker SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
echo "--- tests" docker run --rm -e PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 -v "$PWD":/src:ro -w /src python:3.12-slim \ sh -c "pip install -q --root-user-action=ignore -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt && pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider"
echo "--- build $IMAGE:$SHA" docker build --pull -t "$IMAGE:$SHA" -t "$IMAGE:latest" .
echo "--- push" echo "$REGISTRY_PASSWORD" | docker login -u "$REGISTRY_USER" --password-stdin ghcr.io docker push "$IMAGE:$SHA" docker push "$IMAGE:latest" docker logout ghcr.io
echo "--- clean up" # The image is ~2 GB (Whisper, Piper, ONNX, FFmpeg): keep only what was just pushed, so the build disk doesn't fill. docker images "$IMAGE" --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | grep -v -e ":latest$" -e ":$SHA$" | xargs -r docker rmi || true docker image prune -f >/dev/null docker builder prune -f --filter "until=24h" >/dev/null df -h / | tail -1
